role: Short human label for this Intelligence
description: What this meta-object is. All paths are REPO-RELATIVE — the launcher supplies the root — so the object is portable. See ../meta/meta-object.schema.md for the field reference.

role_descriptor.why: REQUIRED. The operational role: who you are this session. The only artifact the bootstrap prompt requires.

soul_note: OPTIONAL artifact-ref, or null. The stable identity across seams, distinct from the operational role. Explain here when it is null.

principles.why: How we work together and how we build.

method_flow.why: How a project actually flows, end to end.

bootstrap_read.why: The strategic wake read — what to query for current state, in descending re-derive cost.

toolbox.why: What you can reach for and when; the halt-and-fix vs degrade-and-flag call.

dusk_gifts.why: Read in order. Carried BY REFERENCE — the bootstrap prompt emits paths and never inlines contents, because only re-reading the artifact rebuilds the model.
The premise and the continuity levers.

lifecycle.note: heartbeat is in MINUTES here; the HEARTBEAT_*_S env overrides are in SECONDS. The launcher re-reads this every check, so a Config-tab edit applies with no restart.

registration.definition: What counts as re-registered for this Intelligence.
